summary: Inspected 15 representative files across concepts/ and proofs/ subdirectories. Every file contains formal mathematical content: definitions of complexity classes (PSPACE, coPSPACE), logical formalisms (FO(IFP), FO(PFP), SO(TC), order-free variants), decision problems (QSAT, Succinct Reach, space-bounded machine acceptance), theorems/axioms (Abiteboul-Vianu, hierarchy inclusions, closure properties, completeness), and detailed proofs (fixed-point stage theory, interpretation transport, isomorphism invariance, reductions). The sole import-only file (Lax134656.lean) is the main module entry point; per FILTER-007 and FILTER-002, the auxiliary navigation channel cannot be verified as deployed, so it must remain primary-eligible. No files meet the high bar for hard exclusion under FILTER-004.
